items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: Ward El-Gazare went, went in with the Mighty Diamonds.

ctx.x: I don't remember Good Enough. It's a, it's a kind of a fast, it's a really funky song. It's a real bouncy. It's a real bouncy. Right. Get back to that. Okay. Uh. How do you, how do you like working with the Mighty Diamonds?
I didn't have to go in with them myself, actually. Ward El-Gazare went, went in with the Mighty Diamonds. So actually, I just saw them around. Mm-hmm. I didn't have to actually work with them.
Do you think there's much to the theory that a lot of reggae originally had its roots in New Orleans music?
